# Sam adds an expense and Priya hears about it

1. Priya has Flat 4B open
2. Sam opens "Add expense" and types "Takeaway curry", $57.40, split equally
3. He leaves Marcus out, and the shares update to $28.70 each
4. He saves it, and it is at the top of the list with a toast
5. Priya's page shows it, and she owes $28.70 more
6. The Notify job tells Priya and Marcus, not Sam
